sonnet.problem: The card puts the false witness in a 'courtroom' and 'takes the stand'. Proverbs 19:5 gives no courtroom setting.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.

sonnet.problem: The joke puts a modern phone on the Bible prince ('that prince's phone NEVER stops buzzing'). This blends the modern image with the Bible setting. Phones should come up only as things people do today, like 'You know when your phone…'.
sonnet.rule: One image only. Never blend the comparison with the Bible setting.

sonnet.problem: Card 13 says the poor man's friends avoid him. That rules out the wrong claim in the next true/false card (card 14), which says they come running back when he pleads.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The setup line 'even a selfish guy would sign up' hints that the answer to the next question is 'Loving himself'. It also makes 'Wasting his time' and 'Making enemies' look wrong.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The joke reuses the punchline shape of Stop 2 card 13 ('…, friend, EVERY step' versus '…, friend, EVERY oven'). Its setup is also weak: a sticky note on every oven doesn't clearly connect to the idea of plans.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
